exposure: Presence or absence of the father or companion during planned caesarean section
Presence of father/companion (control group) vs. absence of father/companion (case group)
cohort: Women who had a planned caesarean section in two French maternities between November 17th 2020 and June 4th 2021.
finding: The absence of the father or companion during planned caesarean section was associated with increased anxiety and stress levels in mothers.
